result.topic_en: Euler finishes the general integration for the pressure p in a fluid flowing through a vessel with friction, expanding it in powers of the friction coefficient α, then sets up a special case (a vertical cylindrical vessel kept full, with an inclined cylindrical pipe and an outlet orifice) and begins evaluating the integrals in the upper vessel.

25. Expediet autem hinc cafus aliquot fpecialiores euolui, quibus effectus frictionis facilius exhiberi poteft. Sit igitur fupremum vas cylindricum verticale ABEF, cuius amplitudo fit $=gg$, et altitudo $AE=a$; deinde huic vafi adiunctus fit tubus cylindricus FCD, longitudinis $DF=b$, et amplitudinis $=ff$, qui cum recta verticali angulum faciat $=\zeta$; in bafi autem inferiori pertufus fit foramine $CD=hh$, per quod aqua effluat, dum vas fuperius continuo plenum conferuatur.
26. * Sumamus primo punctum indefinitum P in tubo fuperiori ABEF: vbi eft $z=g$, $ds=dx$, et $r=\frac{x}{g}$. Hinc ita integrando, vt integralia in fupremo puncto A euanefcant, erit:
$\int e^{\alpha r}$

items.quote: Expediet autem hinc cafus aliquot fpecialiores euolui, quibus effectus frictionis facilius exhiberi poteft.
items.english: It will be useful to work out from this some more special cases, in which the effect of friction can be exhibited more easily.

items.quote: Sit igitur fupremum vas cylindricum verticale ABEF, cuius amplitudo fit $=gg$, et altitudo $AE=a$; deinde huic vafi adiunctus fit tubus cylindricus FCD, longitudinis $DF=b$, et amplitudinis $=ff$, qui cum recta verticali angulum faciat $=\zeta$; in bafi autem inferiori pertufus fit foramine $CD=hh$, per quod aqua effluat, dum vas fuperius continuo plenum conferuatur.
items.english: Let the uppermost vessel ABEF be a vertical cylinder of cross-section gg and height AE = a. Attached to it is a cylindrical pipe FCD of length DF = b and cross-section ff, making an angle ζ with the vertical. Its lower base is pierced by an orifice CD = hh, through which the water flows out while the upper vessel is kept continually full.
